description:
Nestled perfectly between the vibrant Northern Quarter and the lively Ancoats, Swan Street House offers a modern urban living experience like no other in Manchester. This pet-friendly building boasts fully furnished apartments with contemporary designs, creating a stylish and comfortable home. Residents can enjoy exclusive amenities such as resident lounges, co-working spaces, and private meeting rooms, fostering both community and productivity. Swan Street House is more than just a place to live—it's a place to thrive, with regular resident events adding to the vibrant atmosphere.

Apartment highlights:

- A spacious open-plan kitchen/living area with modern appliances; full height fridge/freezer, oven, electric hob, washer/dryer and dishwasher

- Large family bathroom with shower/bath

- Fully furnished modern furniture: double beds, mattresses, wardrobes, bedside units, dining table and chairs, a large sofa, arm chair, media unit and coffee table

- Floor to ceiling windows

Perks of living here:

- Professional management and friendly 24/7 on-site team

- Pet-friendly apartments with no added costs

- On-site maintenance, here to help when you need them

- Access to on-site Resident' Lounges, Co-working Space, Private Meeting Rooms and Rooftop Terrace

- Flexible tenancies from 12 to 36 months

- Resident events with your community

- Exclusive local and nationwide discounts

- The option to paint feature walls

- Super-fast Wi-Fi options where you can pick the package right for you

- Secure car parking spaces available to rent and EV charging (subject to availability )
